requirement_interpretation: CW-12 requires immediate fail-close on metadata persistence failure, error visibility, and no implicit resume. It does not require reconstructing a first pause after the persistence operation explicitly failed and a crash leaves no durable evidence; whole-restart reconciliation/unknown hold is CW-15-owned.
recommended_contract: Pause closes local and CW-11 admission before persistence.
Append succeeds only after file and parent-directory fsync.
Any persistence failure keeps the current process paused, exposes persistence_error, blocks resume/automatic dispatch, and preserves observation.
Readable, corrupt, mismatched, or resume_failed evidence restores fail-closed.
Namespace loss after an explicitly failed first persistence operation is recorded as a recovery boundary, not claimed as recovered by CW-12; CW-15 must hold missing/unknown recovery state.
event_correlation: turn_stop_observed requires manager role, after-cursor event, exact non-empty abortRequestId, exact known bound manager sessionId and generation, and unchanged pause/run binding; it proves stop observation only.
